title: More Binary Risks In A World Of Binary Choices
gist: Gavekal's Louis-Vincent Gave says the Republican Party took a beating in the US midterms and frames the result as regime change across the US triggered by Trump's Iran war; paywalled, only the opening is available.

insights.claim: Louis-Vincent Gave states that the Republican Party took a beating in Tuesday's midterms, so contested-election fears should not be a big issue this cycle.
insights.speaker: Louis-Vincent Gave
insights.so_what: Clear result lowers the risk of an election-challenge shock.
insights.quote: the Republican Party took a beating in Tuesday’s midterms

insights.claim: He argues that Donald Trump's war to achieve regime change in Iran ended up triggering regime change across the US.
insights.speaker: Louis-Vincent Gave
insights.so_what: Links the Iran war to political backlash.
